digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 21 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Rust, TypeScript, Python）和 15 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「其他热门」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT
repos.description: AutoGPT is the vision of accessible AI for everyone, to use and to build on. Our mission is to provide the tools, so that you can focus on what matter
repos.summary_zh: 开源自主 AI 智能体平台，让任何人都能搭建并运行自动化任务，无需深度编程即可实现复杂目标

repos.name: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
repos.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 290+ providers (90+ free), 500+ models — Kimi, Claude, GPT, OpenAI, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniM
repos.summary_zh: 统一 API 网关接入 290+ 模型与 90+ 免费服务，一套密钥兼容 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流 AI 编码工具

repos.name: vercel-labs/agent-browser
repos.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 写的 AI 浏览器自动化 CLI，让 Agent 像人一样操作网页并提取数据

repos.name: esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix
repos.description: DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for your terminal. Engineered around prefix-cache stability — leave it running.
repos.summary_zh: 终端常驻的 DeepSeek 原生 AI 编程助手，靠前缀缓存稳定性实现零重启长跑

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: BurntSushi/ripgrep
repos.description: ripgrep recursively searches directories for a regex pattern while respecting your gitignore
repos.summary_zh: 命令行搜索速度王者，递归匹配正则时自动尊重 gitignore，让代码检索快如闪电

repos.name: vuejs/core
repos.description: 🖖 Vue.js is a progressive, incrementally-adoptable JavaScript framework for building UI on the web.
repos.summary_zh: 渐进式前端框架，虚拟DOM与响应式系统驱动现代Web界面开发，生态成熟且性能卓越

repos.name: cypress-io/cypress
repos.description: Fast, easy and reliable testing for anything that runs in a browser.
repos.summary_zh: 前端测试界的瑞士军刀，让浏览器里的任何东西都能快速可靠地自动化验证，开发者体验极佳

repos.name: servo/servo
repos.description: Servo aims to empower developers with a lightweight, high-performance alternative for embedding web technologies in applications.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重写的浏览器引擎，为开发者提供轻量高性能的 Web 嵌入方案，摆脱传统浏览器臃肿束缚

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: lyogavin/airllm
repos.description: AirLLM 70B inference with single 4GB GPU
repos.summary_zh: 单张4GB显卡就能跑70B大模型，通过层外内存调度突破显存墙，让低配设备也能本地推理

repos.name: antirez/ds4
repos.description: DeepSeek 4 Flash and PRO local inference engine for Metal, CUDA and ROCm
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台本地跑 DeepSeek 4 的推理引擎，统一支持苹果、NVIDIA 和 AMD 硬件

repos.name: drumih/turbo-fieldfare
repos.description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B inference in ~2 GB of RAM on any M-series MacBook
repos.summary_zh: 苹果芯片 MacBook 仅需 2GB 内存即可本地运行 Gemma 4 26B-A4B，突破大模型硬件门槛

repos.name: FareedKhan-dev/kimi-k3-in-c
repos.description: A 2.78-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 running inference on a single CPU in 8.24 GB of RAM. Portable C99: no BLAS, no framework, no GPU.
repos.summary_zh: 2.78万亿参数大模型仅用8.24GB内存跑在单CPU上，纯C99无任何依赖，极致优化颠覆推理门槛

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: MoonshotAI/PerceptionBench
repos.description: PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
repos.summary_zh: 专测多模态大模型原子级视觉感知的基准，填补细粒度视觉理解评估空白

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
repos.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface.
repos.summary_zh: 最强模块化扩散模型图形界面与后端，节点式工作流让 AI 绘画管线自由搭建

repos.name: tailwindlabs/tailwindcss
repos.description: A utility-first CSS framework for rapid UI development.
repos.summary_zh: 原子化 CSS 框架，用预设工具类快速拼装界面，彻底告别手写样式表

repos.name: CherryHQ/cherry-studio
repos.description: AI productivity studio with smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ assistants. Unified access to frontier LLMs
repos.summary_zh: 开源 AI 生产力全家桶，聚合 300+ 助手与前沿大模型，智能对话加自主 Agent 一站式搞定

repos.name: tokio-rs/tokio
repos.description: A runtime for writing reliable asynchronous applications with Rust. Provides I/O, networking, scheduling, timers, ...
repos.summary_zh: Rust 异步编程的事实标准运行时，提供高性能 I/O 与任务调度，让异步代码可靠且易写

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: donnemartin/system-design-primer
repos.description: Learn how to design large-scale systems. Prep for the system design interview. Includes Anki flashcards.
repos.summary_zh: 系统设计面试圣经，用图解和案例拆解大型架构，配 Anki 卡助你死记硬背

repos.name: zed-industries/zed
repos.description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
repos.summary_zh: Atom 和 Tree-sitter 团队打造的 Rust 高性能多人协作编辑器，主打极速响应与实时结对编程

repos.name: dani-garcia/vaultwarden
repos.description: Unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust, formerly known as bitwarden_rs
repos.summary_zh: 自托管密码管理首选，Rust 重写 Bitwarden 服务端，轻量高效且完整兼容官方客户端

repos.name: microsoft/AI-For-Beginners
repos.description: 12 Weeks, 24 Lessons, AI for All!
repos.summary_zh: 微软官方出品的24节AI入门课，12周带零基础开发者从原理到实战掌握AI核心技能

papers.title: CalibForge: Adversarial Solver Calibration for Scaling Learnable Terminal Tasks
papers.abstract: Training terminal agents requires executable and verifiable tasks that are not merely solvable, but appropriately challenging for learning. Executable validation establishes feasibility, yet does not

papers.title: The Low Frequency Trap: Video Language Models Fail at Simple Event Bookkeeping
papers.abstract: Real-world video benchmarks provide broad coverage, but their fixed clips entangle event count, rate, duration, and visual complexity, making failure modes hard to isolate. While existing programmatic

papers.title: Challenges in Evaluating Explanation Methods for Static and Evolving Data

papers.title: RRC: Unlocking Generative Reward Models in LLM Reinforcement Learning via Ranking-Based Reward Construction
papers.abstract: Recent advances in reward modeling show a paradigm shift from discriminative reward models to generative reward models. However, despite their strong capabilities in response ranking, generative rewar

papers.title: Investigating Artificial Intelligence Digital Sovereignty in Mobile Shopping Apps: A Case Study of Nigeria
papers.abstract: The use of e-commerce mobile applications is expanding in Nigeria, creating both opportunities and risks, including fraud and reduced user control over digital technologies, raising concerns about dig
papers.summary_zh: 针对尼日利亚移动购物应用中的AI数字主权问题展开案例研究，揭示AI应用削弱用户控制权并增加欺诈风险，提出增强用户主权与安全性的治理框架

papers.title: Optimal Rates for Learning with Monotone Adversaries
